About
Bamboula's is the most exciting club on World-Famous Frenchmen St in New Orleans. Great Live Music, Great Food, Great Drinks. Enjoy what N'Awlins is known for in the heart of the Faubourg Marigny Music District at 514 Frenchmen St.
